caption: The drawing features a single vase, centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The vase is rendered in shades of pale blue and gray, with some areas appearing almost white, giving a ceramic or porcelain appearance. The surface of the vase is decorated with an ornate relief pattern of large flowers, likely poppies, and leafy foliage, with the floral elements prominently raised and overlapping one another. The flowers are depicted with multiple petals and detailed centers, while leaves and curved tendrils fill the spaces between and around the flowers. The vase has a narrow neck that flares outward at the rim, and its body is widest near the middle, tapering slightly towards the base. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition, and the background remains undecorated, drawing focus to the intricate design of the vase.
title: Milk Glass Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
